# One set of books for every marketplace you sell on.

> Free private tool for resellers: drop your eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot and Shopify reports and get one monthly profit and loss, what each channel really keeps, and a Schedule C style worksheet. Add a mileage log CSV and sourcing and post office trips go on Schedule C line 9 at the IRS standard mileage rate for each trip's date (72.5 cents to June 30 2026, 76 cents from July 1 2026). Add your inventory log (sourcing sheet CSV: item or SKU, quantity, cost, date bought) and it fills in Schedule C Part III for the year: opening inventory (line 35), purchases (36), closing inventory (41) and cost of goods sold (42), matching each sold unit to the oldest purchase on hand. With the inventory log it also lists the stock still on hand at December 31 by age (0 to 90 days, 91 to 180, 181 to 365, over a year), item by item with the money that has waited longest first and how much of each item sold in the year, and flags stock bought over a year earlier. Depop's Download sales file (three months a file) is read too: item price plus buyer shipping as sales, the label, Depop fee, Depop Payments fee and boosting as deductions, refunds as returns, buyer-paid sales tax and the Buyer Marketplace Fee kept out of sales, and a sale repeated across overlapping downloads counted once. Whatnot's Seller Weekly Orders Report (one CSV a week) is read by the column names in Whatnot's help article: each Order Earnings row a sale dated when it completed (UTC), priced after your coupons, with commission, processing and the taxes on them as fees; refunds and shipping charges taken off the sale they belong to across all the weeks loaded; giveaways kept as $0 sales with their shipping as the loss. Nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/reseller-books/)
- [Seller Books](https://seller-books.marisstella.app/signup): the separate hosted app for keeping these books month to month in an account (reports uploaded and saved); open on a free plan of one platform and 25 orders a month, paid plans not on sale yet.
- [For online sellers](https://marisstella.app/industries/online-sellers/): the problems, Seller Books and the free seller tools on one page.
